name: SATECH
summary: Adelaide dialup ISP ('South Australian Technologies', operated by Silicom Pty Ltd), formed late 1995 from the merger of the APANA nodes box.apana.org.au and lemon.apana.org.au; became Box Internet.

events.details: South Australian Technologies formed from the box + lemon APANA-node merger.
Became Box Internet (satech.net.au redirected to box.net.au).
